title: Dreaming by the River
description: A young woman with blue and purple hair sits pensively on the riverbank in the foreground, resting her chin on her gloved hand beside a brown handbag. Behind her, a serene river reflects a surreal twilight landscape featuring floating islands with glowing trees, firefly-like dragons flying through the sky, and a vibrant mix of sunset and starry night colors.
